test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'PINKYS' is written as 'OJMLXT' and 'TORQUE' is written as 'SPQRTF'. How will 'GAMPST' be written in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• 'PINKYS' is written as 'OJMLXT'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f01fa0d3916aa377587397b99b796f386677ee7c0d4699417f24b624f5f3ac5.png] 

And

 
• 'TORQUE' is written as 'SPQRTF'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9d03b5beefe311ec02fc14d526a2d66bd1b7c8df69502dea25a6a1fe7da4a3e.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'GAMPST' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42a8cb44a384fcbd9da4bd3741716b968302758cf8fafd352c78644245d762c6.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FBLQRU".**
